capabilities: Tracks due, overdue, and review-due tasks in a Today tab
Schedules spaced reviews at fixed 1/3/7/15/30-day intervals
Generates rule-based note summaries without an LLM
Reads notes aloud with system Web Speech voices
Writes all-day .ics reminders with advance alarms
disambiguation: Not a cloud or LLM knowledge workbench; it is a fully offline local plugin, and its neural TTS path is shelved.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.7.2+; reminders need the .ics imported into a system calendar since the plugin has no background process; Android WebView lacks Web Speech so a saved transcript is used instead; cloud neural TTS shelved since v1.0.2; index.json is rebuildable and notes are never modified without explicit opt-in commands.
motivation: To bring the online knowledge workbench's capabilities into Obsidian as a native plugin while keeping all data local and offline.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in view grouping due and overdue tasks, spaced review scheduling, note statistics, and in-app read-aloud, while online workbenches require network access.
summary: Local-first workbench that organizes notes by tags and folders, tracks due tasks and spaced reviews, and reads notes aloud with zero network requests.
